ORAL ORDER 2 18-09-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.
2.

The petitioner has prayed for regular bail in a case registered for the offence punishable under sections 420, 376, 504, 506/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the Prevention of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

entities.text: Prevention of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. According to the prosecution, the petitioner is alleged to have established physical relationship with the informant who is victim of this case.
The petitioner also created a fake Aadhaar card of the victim, which was presented to the owner of the room where they lived and pretended to be husband and wife.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence.
He has Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.61944 of 2023(2) dt.18-09-2023 falsely been implicated in this case.
From perusal of FIR, it seems there is consensual relationship between the petitioner and the victim.
Admittedly, their relation was converted into marriage which was registered by the Marriage Officer, West Champaran at Bettiah.

Subsequently, the victim went to her paternal home, where she developed illicit relation with someone other, and was not ready to lead conjugal life with the petitioner thereafter, the petitioner filed Matrimonial Case No. 346 of 2022 for restitution of conjugal right u/s 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act.

sentences.text: about 20 years according to the FIR
. The entire allegation against the petitioner seems false and concocted.
The petitioner has got no criminal antecedent as stated in para-3 of the bail petition.
It is further submitted that the petitioner is languishing in judicial custody since 30.5.2023.
5. Learned APP appearing for the state has opposed the prayer of regular bail.
6. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and considering the facts and circumstances of the case as well as custody of the petitioner, this court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

The above named petitioner is directed to be released on bail in connection with Bettiah Mahile P.S.
Case No. Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.61944 of 2023(2) dt.18-09-2023 19 of 2023 on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Additional Sessions Judge-VI-cum Special Judge under POCSO Act, West Champaran at Bettiah.

(Sunil Kumar Panwar, J) Manishkr/-
